long_biography.plain_text:
Crowley grew up around Ken's Foods, founded in 1958 when his parents began bottling the popular dressing served at Ken's Steak House. He and his brother Brian later assumed control as the second generation, and Crowley became president. The company expanded from a one-product basement operation into a national manufacturer serving retail and foodservice customers.

As chief executive, Crowley has stressed variety, recipe development and the flexibility to create custom or regionally tailored formulations. Ken's Foods remains family owned, producing more than 1,000 varieties of dressings and sauces across four manufacturing plants. His career therefore combines inherited ownership with sustained operating stewardship of the family enterprise.
